beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Straight from the river, still carrying his Father's words — this is my beloved Son — Jesus was led by the Spirit up into the wilderness. Not by accident. Led there. Before the teaching, before the miracles, there was going to be a battle, and it was going to happen in the emptiest place in the country: bare rock, dead heat, and silence.
